jobs.title: Sales Executive
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced Sales Executive to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for promoting and selling our commercial vehicles and services to potential customers. You will build relationships with clients, understand their needs, and provide solutions that meet their requirements.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or related field
2+ years of experience in sales, preferably in automotive industry

jobs.title: Service Technician
jobs.description: Join our service team as a Service Technician. You will be responsible for diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining commercial vehicles. This role requires technical expertise, attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering high-quality service to our customers.
requirements: Diploma or ITI in Automobile Engineering
3+ years of experience in vehicle servicing
Ability to work with diagnostic tools

jobs.title: Parts Manager
jobs.description: We are seeking a Parts Manager to oversee our spare parts inventory and operations. The successful candidate will manage inventory levels, coordinate with suppliers, ensure timely delivery of parts, and maintain accurate records. This role requires strong organizational and leadership skills.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or related field
5+ years of experience in inventory management
Knowledge of automotive parts and systems

jobs.title: Customer Service Representative
jobs.description: We need a friendly and professional Customer Service Representative to handle customer inquiries, complaints, and provide support. You will be the first point of contact for customers and play a crucial role in maintaining customer satisfaction and building long-term relationships.
requirements: 1+ years of experience in customer service
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously

jobs.title: Accountant
jobs.description: Join our finance team as an Accountant. You will be responsible for maintaining financial records, preparing reports, managing accounts payable and receivable, and ensuring compliance with financial regulations. This role requires attention to detail and strong numerical skills.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance
Knowledge of accounting software (Tally, SAP, etc.)

jobs.title: Marketing Executive
jobs.description: We are looking for a creative Marketing Executive to develop and implement marketing strategies. You will be responsible for creating marketing campaigns, managing social media presence, organizing events, and building brand awareness. This role requires creativity and strong communication skills.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field
